package.name: aav_joy_alive_rs
package.description: joy_alive in Rust (rclrs): the default since 17 Nov (Ben: "I don't think we want to do this again later"), in place of aav_safety's Python one (removed 20 Nov). The same node name, topics and parameters: /drivers/joy/joy passes on as /drivers/joy/joy_checked only while the joystick is really there and moving (OK, WAITING, SILENT, FROZEN on /drivers/joy/alive). The rules are the joy-alive-core crate, with no ROS, checked against joy_alive.py's answers.
